== Summary ==
No one is named in the source.

== Description ==

Play at the tables. At the [[2003 Wisconsin State Championship]], Misty Mountain Games, Madison, Wisconsin, 7 June 2003.

== Source and credit ==

Photographer: [[Nick Kolnik]] (bluethrawn), who wrote of "the rest of the pictures I took at WI States" in [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=28951#28951 post 28951] in "2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend" (topic 1291), 9 June 2003. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]. He announced "77 pictures from MN's Invasion of WI States" at http://wistates.mnswccg.com/pictures.html in [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=29309#29309 post 29309] in "2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend" (topic 1291), 13 June 2003. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]. That gallery page has no Internet Archive capture, so the picture's own caption is not known; this file is one of the 27 images from its folder that were captured.

* '''Source caption:''' none (gallery page not captured)
* '''Original image:''' http://wistates.mnswccg.com/images/2003championship/P1010034.JPG. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030722102600/http://wistates.mnswccg.com:80/images/2003championship/P1010034.JPG Internet Archive]
* '''Date photographed:''' 7 June 2003
